item.title: Middle East war live: Iran examines new US proposal as Trump says talks are in 'final stages'
item.description: Iran on Wednesday said it was examining a new US proposal, transmitted by mediator Pakistan, to end the war in the Middle East even as the two sides continued to trade threats over resuming attacks. Speaking in Washington, US President Donald Trump told reporters that negotiations were in their “final stages”. Follow our liveblog for the latest developments.

item.title: Early War Goal Was to Install Hard-Line Former President as Iran’s Leader
item.description: An Israeli strike designed to free Mahmoud Ahmadinejad from house arrest in Tehran, U.S. officials said, was part of an effort to bring about regime change and put him in power.

item.title: Mamdani won't attend Israel Day Parade, breaking decades-long mayoral tradition amid antisemitism surge
item.description: NYC's Israel Day Parade expects record turnout after Mayor Mamdani confirmed he will not attend, drawing criticism from Jewish leaders citywide.

item.title: Video Shows Itamar Ben-Gvir Taunting Pro-Palestinian Activists
item.description: The national security minister, Itamar Ben-Gvir, posted a video in which he is seen with handcuffed activists forced to kneel on the deck of a ship. It drew a rebuke from Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

item.title: As Palestinians mark Nakba, Israelis celebrate conquest of East Jerusalem
item.description: On May 15, Palestinians commemorated the Nakba ("catastrophe" in Arabic), referring to the forced exodus of Palestinians during the creation of the State of Israel in 1948. Around the same time, Israelis celebrated what they call the "reunification of Jerusalem" in 1967, meaning the occupation and then annexation of the Palestinian part of the city. One land, two historical narratives. Is it still possible to reconcile them? FRANCE 24's Claire Duhamel and Amira Souilem report.

item.title: Israel far-right finance minister says ICC prosecutor seeks arrest warrant against him
item.description: Israel's far-right Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich said on Tuesday the International Criminal Court prosecutor had sought an arrest warrant against him, blaming the Palestinian Authority for the move. Smotrich said Israel would respond by ordering the evacuation of the Palestinian Bedouin community of Khan al-Ahmar in the occupied West Bank.

item.title: Trump says US may hit Iran again, claims Tehran wants deal
item.description: US President Donald Trump said that the United States may need to attack Iran again and claimed that he had been only an hour away from deciding ‌on a fresh strike before he allegedly postponed the attack. Thousands of people have been killed in Iran, Lebanon and the wider Middle East since the US-Israeli war against Iran began at the end of February. Read our blog to see how the day's events unfolded.

item.title: Hezbollah support endures in south Lebanon as ceasefire fails to stop war with Israel
item.description: Despite continuing Israeli attacks and occupation, many people in the south still believe the armed group is the only force capable of defending them.
